rationales.authenticity: Raspberry leaf tea is period-appropriate; the frank advice and humor fit a 1820 midwife; 'mo chara' adds personal warmth.
rationales.character: Brigid's practical midwifery expertise, warm humor at male clients' expense, and proactive care all ring true.
rationales.craft: Three substantive sentences with good rhythm and an amusing deflation; slightly over-explanatory but the humor and detail justify the length.
rationales.language: Clear and colloquial; one minor grammatical slip ('best to send word when the pains begin proper' is slightly elliptical).
rationales.responsiveness: Comprehensively addresses the timing question, offers preparatory advice, and shows professional readiness.
